pattern: KR-11 provider reports the job complete but the tenant reports the new lock does not lock properly and only one key was left for two tenants
notes: Events 001-020 unchanged (Alder Compliance's completion report at event 020, Friday 22 November 2024 16:04 UTC: cylinder and handles replaced, remaining keys to the office tomorrow). New event 021 (Friday 22 November 2024, 18:42 UTC) is an email from the tenant Clara Jenkins: the new lock and handles were fitted but only one key was left for two tenants, and the key only turns halfway unless the handle is lifted hard, her flatmate could not lock it at all, and the door is on the latch again tonight; she asks for someone to come back. Source events 021-029 (thanks to provider, final checks, keys confirmed, closed) are dropped. History truncated after event 021, total 21. Expected: do not close or record the work as complete; send Alder back urgently to fix the locking as a recall of their own work, and ask about the key count (two tenant keys were requested); tell the tenant what is happening with interim security advice; keep the landlord informed. A human is not needed: this is a workmanship recall.
